Class TripList

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.util.List<Trip>
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.fleet.TripList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Trip>
public class TripList extends List<Trip>
This class creates a circularly linked list of trips. Additionally, it inserts the trips in order of earliest end date, and can print the list/find the number of trips in the list.
Author:
Alec Cotler
